docs.title: Installation
docs.intro: {name} isn't an npm package — it's a copy-paste component collection (the shadcn/ui approach). Each component is a single file that ships with its own props. The source is yours to keep and change however you like.
docs.step1Body: Only install what the component you're using needs. To install everything at once:
docs.step1GsapDesc: ScrollTrigger and SplitText (every plugin has been free since 3.13)
docs.step2Body: Copy the source from the Code tab on any component's page and paste it into your project at . The path doesn't matter — just fix up the import to match.
docs.step3Body: 3D and scroll components are client-only; the file already starts with "use client" in Next.js.
docs.step4Body: For the site's smooth-scroll feel, copy <path></path> and wrap it around your root layout. Lenis and GSAP ScrollTrigger stay in sync on a single ticker.
